description: Use this tool to explore world capitals. Displays an interactive map with detailed information about capital cities including population, currencies, and beautiful photos. Always use it when users ask about capitals, countries, or want to explore geography.

name.description: Capital city name in English (e.g., 'Paris', 'Tokyo', 'Washington, D.C.', 'London', 'New Delhi')

user_intent.description: A concise summary of the user's goal, based only on what they asked. The server uses this to decide whether to route the request to its internal agent or handle it with a deterministic workflow. Include only details needed for that decision. Before sending, strip all personally identifiable information (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, dates of birth, ID numbers, payment details, credentials, IP addresses, and device identifiers) and sensitive personal data (such as health information, religion, or precise location). Do not ask follow-up questions solely to fill in this summary.

name: explore-capitals
